description.summary: The Sevaijen-Class ship is the result of research done on combat vessels to combat Vulcan incursions into Imperial space. While the use case is no longer valid, the ship remains a nimble asset to the Imperial Guard.
The ageing Miklon class ships did not present a formidable enough defence against Vulcan incursions. The Kumari was the answer to this with heavier shields and armament.

canon.note: The Kumari is the best-known ship of the class. Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 37.

description.summary: The Miklon class ship has been in the service of the Imperial Guard for more than 50 years. Excellent combat vessel

canon.note: From Star Trek: Armada, as the Andorian Miklon; no wiki page of its own.

description.summary: The Bonaventure class was the first long range exploration cruiser to come from joint shipbuilding operations after the formation of the United Federation of Planets, effectively serving as its' first battleship.

anyOf.name: Form the United Federation of Planets
Form the United Federation of Planets

canon.note: The first ship with warp drive, per Scotty.

description.summary:
The culmination of the Warp 3 Program, designed as both an excellent ship for use in patrolling the Sol System as well as perfecting the warp engine that would later power the NX-Class.
All-rounder, but has low hull integrity and no shields. Good for use in large fleets.

canon.note: On screen as an unnamed Earth class; Eaglemoss calls it the Warp Delta, and Memory Beta the Ganges class. Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 82.

ships.subtitle: Repairs and builds ships and stations

description.summary: An early automated work craft that patches up damaged ships and builds the stations and subsystems a young Starfleet needs.

After the formation of the United Federation of Planets joint shipbuilding operations began, the Daedalus class was the first fruit of these efforts, replacing the NX-Class as the new tip of the spear in both exploration and combat.

anyOf.name: Form the United Federation of Planets
Form the United Federation of Planets

canon.note: Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 100.

description.summary: A fast, unarmed United Earth scout, built to go ahead of the fleet and chart what lies beyond. It carries no weapons, so it relies on speed and distance to stay alive.

Earth's first warp-5 starship and the pride of the NX programme. As the fleet's flagship she leads from the front, launching new construction and serving as a mobile base for the ships around her.
Every Earth ship that follows owes her something. Her crew went further than any humans before them and wrote the book on deep space as they went, and to fly under her flag is to stand at the start of everything Starfleet will become.

canon.note: Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 4.

variants.label: Refit
variants.description: Refit this NX class ship with the latest in Starfleet technology

description.summary:
A scout ship designed as the final iterative step in the Warp 5 Program, the Freedom is capable of going to Warp 4, but has a result of her power-hungry engines, it is only lightly armed.
Non-combat scout

canon.note: Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 118.

description.summary: The Icarus class was developed using prototype space frame designs and proved to be a versatile test bed for many experimental technologies over the years

A step above the Challenger, with more powerful weapons, but sharing the same weakness, relying solely on polarised hull plating for protection.
Heavy frigate for larger fleets.

canon.note: Eaglemoss covers it as the United Earth Starfleet Intrepid. Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 44.

description.summary: The MACO attack shuttle is primarily used for infiltration. Commonly found assigned to Minuteman class ships

canon.note: MACO is a canon organisation, but no vessel of theirs has this name.

description.summary: A light destroyer fitted with boarding pods as well as phasers and spatial torpedoes, able to seize enemy ships rather than destroy them.
The culmination of Henry Archer's dream and first Earth ship to make warp 5, serving as the most powerful ship in the fleet, albeit with the same weaknesses: no shields.

canon.note: Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 4.

variants.label: Refit
variants.description: Refit this NX class ship with the latest in Starfleet technology

description.summary: A Hague-class forward base, among the first that United Earth pushed out beyond its own system. It builds ships, docks small craft and takes in mined dilithium, and its warp inhibitor keeps enemy fleets from jumping in on top of it.
A United Earth destroyer from the years of the Romulan War, trading the NX class's endurance for heavier guns and a faster turn of speed.

canon.note: From Star Trek: Legacy.

description.summary: A small United Earth cargo bee fitted with mining gear. It cuts dilithium from asteroids and ferries it home to the nearest freighter or outpost.
A J-class cargo hauler converted to process dilithium in the field. It carries and maintains its own flight of mining bees, so the fleet's fuel is refined where it's mined.

General fleet support, equipped with phased pulse cannons for anti-strike craft duty, but like all United Earth ships, has the weakness of no shielding.
Anti-fighter/bomber frigate

canon.note: Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 160.

description.summary: Constructs cruisers up to the heaviest capital ships, can also dock one vessel for repairs at a time
Constructs cruisers and light to midweight capital ships, can also dock one vessel for repairs at a time
Enterprise's little two-seat shuttlepod, pressed into service as a strike craft. Fragile, but useful for scouting and drawing fire, and dangerous to larger ships in numbers.

credits.note: From baz1701's NX pack, which includes the NX shuttle pod; attributed

description.summary: The Pralim-class has been the go-to vessel of the Tellarite Navy for a generation. Whether patrolling borders or in heavy combat, this ship will prove its worth.

canon.note: Eaglemoss covers the Tellarite cruiser. Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 115.

variants.label: Refit
variants.description: Refit this Tellarite class ship with heavy cannons obtained from the Tellarite mutual defence pact with the Arkonians

description.summary:
The Sh'ran-Class ship has been on the frontline of Vulcan exploration for more than 50 years.
Excellent support vessel, best suited for screening duty

canon.note: Of the same Suurok class as the Suurok hull.

description.summary: The escalating conflict with the Andorians demanded a larger, more powerful vessel to compete with their frontline battleships. The D'kyr was a logical conclusion

canon.note: Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 55.

description.summary: With the success of the Sh'Raan class a larger vessel was commissioned to take advantages of the solid design. The Suurok is an excellent example of balance between defence and firepower

canon.note: Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 34.

description.summary: The Vahklas is an older design of light destroyer that is not usually used by the Vulcan Defence Force, but has been refit and pressed back into service.

canon.note: Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 88.

description.summary: One of United Earth's first true battleships, built for the line of battle rather than exploration. Slow, but it can take and deal a great deal of punishment.

canon.note: A United Earth battleship in licensed works.

description.summary:
Commissioned in 2149, the Vo'n'talk is a new, effective warship designed to punch very high above its' weight. So much so that it is weak to smaller ships.
Best employed with smaller escorts.

ships.name: Construction Bee
ships.subtitle: Repairs and builds ships and stations

description.summary: A rugged little work craft that repairs the Empire's ships and raises new stations and subsystems wherever the warriors go.
A design that seems destined for greater glory in the future, armed to the teeth, but lacking agility. Perhaps we can recify this...

canon.note: Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection special issue 4.

description.summary: A development of the D4 and Raptor, the D5 is the most heavily armed vessel in the KDF, with multiple disruptor cannons and a massive belly turret. Send the fek'lhr to his doom and earn glory for you and your House!

canon.note: Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 102.

description.summary:
The flagship of the Klingon fleet, a heavily armed command ship that builds and launches new warships as it advances. Where it goes, the battle follows.
No Klingon is given a flagship; it is taken, by deeds the Empire cannot ignore. Her commander answers only to the Council, and her crew sing of her victories in the halls of their Houses.

canon.note: Fits the Klingon names of the Starfleet Command games, but no wiki page confirms it.

description.summary: Designed to kill glob fly fighters with its' heavy disruptor cannons. Qapla'!

canon.note: Named after the Klingon captain of ENT "Bounty"; the class is the mod's own. His transport is Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 71.

description.summary: In hunman terms, this is the 'bread-and-butter' of the Klingon Defence Forces: old, but capable of glorious battle against all comers!.
First strike ship designed to be in and out of a fight before an enemy knows what has hit them, weak against heavy torpedoes.

canon.note: Memory Beta files the K5 under the V's'talo class.

description.summary: A Kan'Qul-class forward base, the Empire's foothold on a new frontier. It builds ships, docks small craft and takes in mined dilithium, and its warp inhibitor keeps raiders from jumping in on top of it.
A newer medium cruiser primarily made to replace the older K18, but it is unproven.

canon.note: Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 41.

description.summary: A Klingon cargo bee fitted with mining gear, cutting dilithium from asteroids to keep the Empire's war fleets fuelled.

ships.name: Mining Freighter
ships.subtitle: Decommissioned Warship Refit for Battlefield Mining Ops

description.summary: Warship hull refit for mining duties on the battlefield, carries and maintains a flight of cargo bees outfitted for mining
The Empire's first orbital shipyard of the era. It builds destroyers and light to medium cruisers and can dock one ship at a time for repairs.
Armed with heavy beam cannons designed to burn enemy ships like they were in the fires of Gre'thor itself!

canon.note: Memory Beta files the Stinger under the D'esta Kar class.

description.summary: A retrofit shuttle repurposed for combat. Its' pilots die in glory.
An attack bomber built to slip past escorts and put torpedoes into enemy capital ships.
Heavy fleet support ship used in fighter/bomber resupply at the front lines and can launch six squadrons of fighters equipped with EMP weapons which can temporarily disable enemy ships

canon.note: Named after Ch'Havran, the Romulans' own name for Remus; the class is the mod's own.

description.summary: Heavy Cruiser equipped with dual plasma disruptors, used in fighter/bomber support at the front lines.

canon.note: Named after Ch'Rihan, the Romulans' own name for Romulus; the class is the mod's own.

ships.name: Construction Bee
ships.subtitle: Repairs and builds ships and stations

description.summary: A discreet automated work craft that repairs Romulan ships and builds new stations and subsystems out of sight of the enemy.
Dreadnought warbird with heavy magentic accelerator cannon. Expensive, but capable of destroying any unshielded enemy warship in one blow if used correctly.

canon.note: Named after Tellus, a Vulcan warrior of Surak's time; the class is the mod's own.

description.summary: Limited availability of captured components from alien starships means that only five of this class of warship have been built

canon.note: The warp-7 stardrive prototype from the novel Kobayashi Maru; no wiki page of its own.

description.summary: A light fighter designed to overwhelm enemy targets with disruptor pulses. Most effective against bombers.

canon.note: Named after the set'leth, a Romulan animal; the craft is the mod's own.

description.summary:
The warbird that led the Romulan fleets against Earth, armed with a mass accelerator cannon alongside its disruptors and torpedoes. It builds and launches new ships from its own bays.
Admiral Valdore led the Romulan war against Earth from her decks. To serve aboard her is to stand close to the Senate's own purpose, and every captain in the fleet watches her signals for their orders, and for any sign of displeasure.

canon.note: Admiral Valdore's flagship in the Earth–Romulan War novels.

description.summary: A nimble light cruiser that carries an EMP projector to knock out enemy systems before its disruptors close in.

canon.note: Named after S'Vath Jo'rek, who unified Romulus; the class is the mod's own.

description.summary: A small, lightly armed but easy to build and mass-produce bird-of-prey. Best used in swarms.

canon.note: Named after Karatek, a Reman of the Vulcan's Soul novels; the class is the mod's own.

credits.note: Romulan War mod for Armada II

description.summary: Boarding cruiser, designed to deposit dozens of Romulan soldiers onto a ship and take it for the Star Empire. To be unknown is to be unconquerable.

canon.note: Named after Pontilus, the first Praetor; the class is the mod's own.

description.summary: A Romulan cargo bee fitted with mining gear. It works the asteroid fields quietly, carrying dilithium back to the nearest freighter or outpost.

description.summary: A Romulan mining freighter that processes dilithium in the field and carries and maintains its own flight of mining bees.
Spy vessel with very low power output designed specifically for enemy observations
A Romulan orbital shipyard that builds destroyers and light to medium cruisers, with a single repair berth.
Cruiser-class warbird. Old and venerable, designed a century ago but sturdy enough to continue to see combat.

canon.note: Named after Vriha t'Rehu, a Romulan empress; the class is the mod's own.

description.summary: A small, fast Tholian vessel armed with a tetryon beam. Working in pairs and groups, these ships spin energy webs that can trap and crush a far larger opponent.

canon.note: The Tholian Web Spinner. Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 129.

description.summary:
The pride of the Terran Empire's fleet, a mirror-universe warship that answers to no one. It builds and launches ships of its own and is armed to rule by force.
In the Terran Empire a captain keeps command only as long as no one takes it, and none is fought over harder than this. She flies the Empire's colours ahead of its fleets, and the worlds she visits learn quickly what obedience means.

canon.note: The Terran Empire's flagship is the mod's own.

description.summary: Scout ship named after Jonathan Archer, designed for getting into and out of enemy controlled space quickly and safely. Quite effective against enemy fighters.

canon.note: A Federation scout in licensed works.

description.summary: The Ares class was a Federation Starfleet battle cruiser that first saw service during the Four Years War. It was the first purpose-built combat vessel constructed by the Federation since the Earth-Romulan War.

canon.note: A Four Years War heavy destroyer from the FASA role-playing game; no wiki page of its own.

description.summary:
The mainstay of the Federation exploration arm and ultimate development of the NX-Class lineage, the Constitution is among the most powerful ships in Starfleet.
Best used as the hard centre of a fleet.

canon.note: Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 50.

ships.subtitle: Repairs and builds ships and stations

canon.note: Demon Renegade's F-FT interceptor, a fan design.

description.summary:
Heavy frigate introduced during the Four Years War as a replacement for older ships from the 22nd Century.
Well-rounded, best used as the core of smaller strike fleets.

canon.note: A fast heavy destroyer from fan works (Star Trek Expanded).

description.summary:
The Federation-Class is the most powerful starship yet developed by Starfleet, this vessel embodies the ideals of the Federation and the will to defend it against all who would threaten it.
Battleship, best used as a flagship of a fleet.

The DY-750 was the last in the illustrious DY line stretching all the way back to the late 20th century with the first sleeper ships in the DY-100 to DY-230 range. Ships of the DY-750 class are primarily used as emergency repair and rescue cruisers along shipping routes by colonial authorities far from the edges of Federation space.

canon.note: Extends the canon DY line; the design is the mod's own.

description.summary:
The most famous Constitution-class starship of her day. As the fleet's flagship she builds and launches new ships, and her phasers and photon torpedoes make her a match for any single opponent.
Under Captain Kirk her five-year mission made her the most famous ship in the Federation. Wherever she flies, she carries the Federation's word: the ship sent first, and trusted most.

canon.note: Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 50.

description.summary: Heavy fighter/bomber with micro-photon torpedoes. Most effective against larger ships.

canon.note: No Federation class of this name; Memory Beta's Lightning class is an Orion ship.

canon.note: After Ralph McQuarrie's concept art; contributed by Major Stress.

description.summary: A Kepler-class outpost of the kind that watched the Neutral Zone. It builds ships, docks small craft and takes in mined dilithium, and its warp inhibitor holds attackers at a distance.
A Starfleet mining bee of the 2260s, cutting dilithium from asteroids and carrying it back to a freighter or outpost for processing.

credits.note: No readme with credits for this model in the mod's source files.

canon.note: The Antares (NCC-501) is eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 63.

description.summary:
Designed as a patrol frigate and light scout, the Saladin is fast, heavily armed for her size and well-protected against most ships in her weight class.
Heavy frigate, best used as bulk of an attack fleet.
Constructs heavy cruisers through to capital sized vessels, can also dock one vessel for repairs at a time
A light Starfleet construction facility for destroyers and light to medium cruisers, with one berth for repairs.
A large orbital starbase: a shipyard, resource depot and safe harbour in one, with a warp inhibitor to protect the space around it.
The first KDF attack bomber designed from the ground up to destroy larger ships. Earn glory by destroying the enemy!

canon.note: A Klingon attack shuttle, a fan design.

ships.subtitle: Repairs and builds ships and stations

description.summary: A work craft of the Imperial fleet that repairs battle damage and raises new stations and subsystems as the Empire expands.
Frontline battlecruiser. Not very effective against small ships

canon.note: Memory Alpha files the D12 with the Bird-of-Prey.

description.summary: Designed in the early half of the 23rd Century to replace many older ships in the KDF, the D3 is a good all around ship with no great strengths or weaknesses.

canon.note: Memory Beta lists more than one D3 class.

description.summary: Descendant of the D4 battlecruiser, the D7 is the ultimate expression of Klingon might. While not the largest ship in the fleet, it is the most sought after!

canon.note: Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 67.

description.summary: The first purpose-built combat fighter in the KDF, allowing a pilot to earn glory and honour more effectively in battle!

canon.note: A fan design.

description.summary:
Koloth's D7 battlecruiser, leading the Klingon fleet. It can cloak, and it builds and launches new warships from its own bays.
Captain Koloth's command, and the ship every Klingon captain on the frontier measures themselves against. She leads the Empire's push towards the Federation border, and where she goes, the fleet follows.

canon.note: Koloth's D7 in "The Trouble with Tribbles".

description.summary: A descendant of the K18 beam cruiser of yesteryear, armed similarly with heavy beam cannons. Perhaps the line's last chance for glory...

canon.note: Memory Beta files the K30 under the K'nel class.

Front line Battleship, excellent frontal attack strength, can launch heavy fighters, moderate point defence strength, very effective against emplacements

canon.note: Memory Beta files the Klingon Predator with the D4 design.

An Imperial mining bee that strips dilithium from asteroids for the Empire's expanding fleets.
Armoured cargo freighter, carries and maintains a flight of cargo bees outfitted for mining
An Imperial shipyard of the 2260s, turning out destroyers and light to medium cruisers and repairing one ship at a time.

The most powerful warship in use by the Star Navy, the Battlehawk is aging, but with recent refits has been brought up to the same standard as the Federation-Class dreadnought and Klingon Ravanous and Predator-Class battleships. Its only weakness, other then massive cost to build, is its slow speed.

A revolutionary design, the T'liss-Class uses a cloaking device and a plasma torpedo launcher capable of devestating most ships in one shot. Later production models also had disruptor cannons mounted to suppliment the long reload time on the launcher.

canon.note: Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 57.

description.summary:
A strange reversal of fortune in which the Romulans take technology from the Klingons, the D7 is a result of alliance between the Empires, giving access to a superior warship in exchange for cloaking technology.
Best used against other capital ships, as it can be overwhelmed by bombers.

canon.note: The Romulans flew D7s in the late 2260s. Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 67.

description.summary: A modern replacement for earlier fighters to keep pace with the Klingons and the Federation. Best suited to destroy enemy bombers.

canon.note: A Star Trek Online design.

canon.note: Named after Gal Gath'thong, a place on Romulus; the flagship is the mod's own.

description.summary: A larger cruiser-class Romulan ship, designed to confront ships like the Destroyat.

abilities.detail: Tal Shiar espionage: reveals cloaked ships across the map.

An older design dating back to the early 2210s, now utilised in the light scout/harassment role to keep an enemy off balance.

Light cruiser designed to engage larger capital ships, but is ill-suited to fight off bombers and fighters.

canon.note: The Sehin Morlatta, or Deathsting.

canon.note: The Enterprise-C is eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 46.

canon.note: Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 52.

A refit of the venerable Constitution-Class, it is more powerful then before, cheaper to build then the Constellation-Class and is often still the gold standard of defence.
Used as either the hard core of a fleet or as part of a larger capital squadron.

canon.note: Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 2.

description.summary:
The ultimate successor to the beloved 'Connie' and future backbone of Starfleet, the Excelsior is a heavily armed and protected starship that is somewhat slow on the turn.

variants.description: Refit this Excelsior with the latest in engine enhancements

canon.note: From Star Trek: Shattered Universe.

description.summary:
The Excelsior-class Enterprise-B, a larger and more powerful successor to the Constitution class. As the fleet's flagship she builds and launches new ships from her own bays.
The third ship to carry the name, and the first to carry it without Kirk at her helm. Her name alone carries the weight of the two ships before her, and Starfleet sends her where it most needs to be seen.

canon.note: The Excelsior-class Enterprise-B. Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 40.

description.summary:
Designed to carry the Wraith, Spectre and Phantom class fighters into combat, the Midway serves as effectively a small, mobile starbase and replenishment facility for its embarked squadrons.
Best used with an escort of Akulas and Centaurs.

Designed to compliment the Constitution-Class but be far easier and faster to build, this very versatile ship can be equipped with either:
a Torpedo Roll-bar: Photon Torpedoes
Sensor Suite: Enhanced Sensors, Cloak Detection, Phaser Turret
Phaser Cannons: Two heavy sideslung phaser cannons

canon.note: Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 11.

Scout ship designed at the dawn of the 23rd Century, but heavily refit for modern use.

canon.note: Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection special issue 24.

description.summary: A Miranda-class frigate seized by Khan Noonien Singh. Under his command she is a dangerous raider, with phasers and photon torpedoes and a captain who will stop at nothing.

While lightly armed, they are heavily shielded and armored to protect the boarders within, but still require escorts.

With heavier shields, armour and weapons, the Keldon is the smallest battleship and the cheapest, but suffers from shortcomings due to using the Galor's frame. To offset these, captured Romulan cloaking devices can be installed.

description.summary: A modern automated work craft that mines, salvages wrecks and repairs damaged ships wherever Starfleet needs it.

credits.note: No readme with credits for this model in the mod's source files.

description.summary: Originally designed as a larger vessel, the Defiant was redesigned in 2367 by Benjamin Sisko to be the most powerful ship in her size range, but lack of foresight led to a number of design flaws that would keep the ship out of mass production. Combat trials with the refurbished prototype showed the need for a smaller, less powerful warp core for mass production. Once fitted, the Defiant was quickly brought into mass production

canon.note: Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 9.

description.summary: A Peregrine-class attack fighter, launched in numbers from carriers to harass larger ships with pulse phasers.

canon.note: The Federation attack fighter. Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 68.

description.summary:
The Sovereign-class Enterprise-E, flagship of the Federation. Built with the Borg in mind, she carries quantum torpedoes and some of Starfleet's strongest phaser arrays, and builds and launches new ships from her bays.
Captain Picard's Enterprise, built for a galaxy that had met the Borg. She is the Federation's flagship, and when Starfleet must make a stand, she is the ship it sends.

canon.note: Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 21.

description.summary:
Intended to be the new face of Starfleet's exploritory efforts for the next century, the Galaxy-Class has been pressed into combat as the new standard capital ship for Starfleet's battle groups.
Capable of seperating its saucer in emergency situations.

canon.note: Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 1.

description.summary: Designed in 2370 as a deep-space exploration vessel with teeth, the Intrepid underwent a minor design change after the incident in the Hekaras Corridor. Faster then almost any ship in the fleet, the Intrepid can hold her own against most ships in her weight range, but will struggle against larger ships.

canon.note: The Voyager is eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 6.

description.summary: Designed as the final iterative step in the Galaxy Development Program and to serve the Galaxy as was the Miranda was to the Contitution, the Nebula Class starships have been refitted for combat against the Borg and the Dominion. With an extensive array of multi-purpose weaponry and new technology at its disposal the Nebula is a great compliment to the Federation fleet. In addition to the Nebula's phaser banks, it can be outfitted with three different modules to suit the tactical situation.

canon.note: Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 23.

credits.note: Built from the SNS Galaxy parts

variants.label: Adv. Sensor Phalanx
variants.description: Adds an Advanced long range Sensor Phalanx

description.summary: Another replacement for the Miranda-Class in the logistical role, the Norway is far larger and more heavily armed then the Miranda, allowing it to hold its own in battle against the Cardassians and the Borg after Wolf 359.

canon.note: Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 61.

description.summary:
The long-awaited successor to the Oberth, the Nova was originally the concept for the Defiant-Class until Benjamin Sisko took over the project. Starfleet resurrected the design to succeed the Oberth as a scout vessel.
Can be retrofit to lay mines.

canon.note: The Equinox is eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 15.

description.summary: A Regula II-class outpost, the modern successor to Starfleet's frontier bases. It builds ships, docks small craft and takes in mined dilithium, and its warp inhibitor keeps enemy fleets from jumping in on top of it.
Converted Academy flight trainer and courier for anti-capital attack. Not very effective against small ships.
A Starfleet phaser platform that guards a set area against small ships. Best placed in groups to cover each other.

abilities.name: Manheim effect
abilities.detail: Superweapon: a temporal field that freezes ships in place.

description.summary: A warship from Starfleet's future, armed with advanced phaser arrays and quantum torpedoes.
An unmanned Starfleet sensor probe that relays data from an area of space without risking a ship or crew.

The latest from Starfleet R&D, the Prometheus is a formidable, if exceptionally complicated, warship already it can create a tactical advantage where none exists by splitting into three semi-independent starships with its Multi Vector Assault Mode

canon.note: Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 25.

description.summary: A Starfleet engineering support ship that projects power onto allied shields and carries the parts and crews to repair damage in the field.

canon.note: Named after the canon Antares-class freighter; its role here is the mod's.

description.summary: A modern Starfleet mining bee that cuts dilithium from asteroids and ferries it to the nearest freighter or outpost for processing.
A Starfleet dilithium freighter that refines fuel in the field and carries and maintains its own flight of mining bees.

Designed to replace the Miranda-Class in patrol and logistical roles, the Sabre is far more heavily armed then the base Miranda, but production only ramped up after Wolf 359.
Best used in 'wolfpacks' alongside Defiants.

canon.note: Spelt Sabre here, the Australian way. Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 56.

description.summary: Constructs most Federation starships, can also dock one vessel for repairs at a time
A Starfleet shipyard for escorts, destroyers and light to medium cruisers, with one berth for repairs.

The Sovereign is the Federation's second most advanced starship, designed as the most conventional and ultimately successful option to defend against the Borg. The Sovereign is heavily shielded and armed with powerful phasers and quantum torpedoes.

canon.note: Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 21.

description.summary: A huge orbital spacedock that builds and repairs whole fleets, stores resources and protects the space around it with a warp inhibitor.

The Steamrunner-Class was originally produced during the Cardassian Wars in the 2350s, but undersaw a massive refit program in 2368 after Wolf 359 to defend against the Borg. As a result, the Steamrunner is armed with long range Tricobalt torpedoes. These torpedoes can be fired from long range and cause massive explosions that damage everything within range. As a consequence for the tremendous energy it takes to fire its weapons, the Steamrunner tends to be slower and have less shielding than its counterparts, making it an easy target if engaged at close range.

canon.note: Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 54.

description.summary: The brainchild of Dr Paul Manheim, this station is the first generation of applied temporal warfare
A fixed Starfleet photon torpedo launcher for holding off capital ships. Best placed in groups.
A Starfleet carrier that launches squadrons of strike craft from its hangars, backed by pulse phasers and quantum torpedoes.
The first generation Valkyrie-Class fighter,armed with fore and aft pulse phasers give excellent defensive capabilities.

canon.note: From Star Trek: Invasion.

description.summary: Heavier version of the Mk I Valkyrie, dual forward pulse phasers make it harder hitting on strafing runs

canon.note: From Star Trek: Invasion.

description.summary: The largest fighter in the Valkyrie series, this craft sports a phaser strip on the nose of the craft, making it suited for anti-capital duities.

canon.note: From Star Trek: Invasion.

credits.note: Valkyrie Mk II and III from Star Trek: Invasion

description.summary: The Venture is one of the newest additions to Starfleet, with production beginning in 2373. It is a lightly armoured highly manoeuvrable scout vessel capable of space and atmospheric flight. This vessel is primarily designed for reconnaissance and short range exploration. It is equipped with a forward firing pulse phaser, should it need to engage in combat.

canon.note: Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 80.

description.summary: A Ferengi marauder, more trader than warship. It carries no weapons in this fleet, and would rather buy its way out of a fight than shoot.
Capital ship killer. Extremely effective in numbers. Not very effective against small ships.

canon.note: No page on Memory Alpha or Memory Beta, and nothing found on the web; the mod's own as far as the sources show.

description.summary: A civilian orbital station handling the traffic of a Klingon world. It takes no part in the fighting.
An orbital depot that rearms and resupplies the Empire's warships.
A civilian trading post where Klingon merchants do business. It takes no part in the fighting.
Freighter outfitted with construction equipment, carries and maintains a flight of construction bees which can repair starships

ships.subtitle: Repairs and builds ships and stations

description.summary: A work craft that repairs the Defence Force's ships and builds new stations and subsystems wherever the fleet fights.
Successor of the K'tInga. Highly manoeuvrable. Not very effective against small ships

canon.note: Fits the Klingon names of the Starfleet Command games, but no wiki page confirms it. E7 is a Star Fleet Battles hull code.

description.summary: The Fek'lhr was named after the mythical Klingon beast and guardian of Gre'thor, the Klingon afterlife for the dishonoured. The Fek'lhr is armed with disruptors, but can be outfitted with powerful weapons allowing it to unleash waves of destruction on its enemies. The weaponry on the Fek'lhr is so unpredictable that a separate facility is necessary to contain its equipment.

canon.note: From Star Trek: Armada.

description.summary: A light Klingon gunship, fast and cheap. Good at reconnaissance and diversions, and in numbers able to wear down much larger ships.

canon.note: No page on Memory Alpha or Memory Beta, and nothing found on the web; the mod's own as far as the sources show.

description.summary:
The Negh'Var, flagship of the Klingon Defence Force and the largest warship in the Empire. It can cloak, and it builds and launches new warships from its own bays.
Chancellor Gowron's flagship, and the largest warship the Empire has ever built. To serve aboard her is the highest honour the Defence Force can give, and when she leads, the whole Empire is watching.

canon.note: Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 47.

description.summary: The Jach'eng, built out of the Shockwave Facility, is crewed with the bravest and most loyal warriors in the fleet. Officers assigned duty on a Jach'eng are listed as killed in action, as the vessel departs from the shipyard. They do not ever intend to come back. Captaining a Jach'eng Class vessel is considered one of the highest honours a Klingon warrior can achieve.

canon.note: The Klingon shockwave ship of the Star Trek: Armada games; no wiki page of its own.

description.summary: Concentrated power. Excellent front line killer. Main assault ship. Not very effective against small ships

canon.note: Fits the Klingon names of the Starfleet Command games, but no wiki page confirms it.

description.summary: More expensive, heavier, more armoured, more firepower version of the Kron with more support ability

canon.note: No page on Memory Alpha or Memory Beta, and nothing found on the web; the mod's own as far as the sources show.

description.summary: A development of the B'rel lineage, the K'vort is an enlarged vessel with more powerful weapons, but suffers from lack of maneuverability, making it unable to bring its' weapons to bear on smaller targets.

canon.note: The K'vort is the larger Bird-of-Prey. Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 35.

description.summary: The Negh'Var is the flagship of the Klingon Defence Force, as well as the most powerful ship in the fleet. Commissioned by Chancellor Gowron, its massive disruptors, photon torpedo launchers, powerful shields, and large crew compliment are used to defend the borders of the Klingon Empire against any foe. There are few ships in the galaxy that can withstand the combined force of a fleet of Negh'Vars.

canon.note: Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 47.

variants.label: Heavy Pulse Cannons
variants.description: Upgrade multi-phase locked power converters to enable powering of Heavy Pulse Cannons

description.summary: The NuQ'Duj is a fast and mobile fighter used primarily for scouting and patrolling the Neutral Zone. It is both a blessing and a curse for a Klingon officer to command. These scouts are only equipped with one forward firing disruptor cannon, preventing its captain from gaining much honour in battle. However, most of these scout ships are destroyed in combat, and dying in battle is a great honour for a Klingon.

canon.note: From Star Trek: Armada.

description.summary: A Ty'Gokor-class outpost, named for the fortress of the Klingon High Command. It builds ships, docks small craft and takes in mined dilithium, and its warp inhibitor keeps enemy fleets from jumping in on top of it.
Remote sensor used to keep an eye on the enemy when our warriors are unavailable
A fixed Klingon disruptor battery that tears into small ships. Best placed in groups.
A Klingon support ship that keeps warriors in the fight, boosting allied shields and repairing battle damage on the spot.

canon.note: Named after Antaak, a Klingon physician of ENT; the ship is the mod's own.

description.summary: The Klingon Dilithium Collector uses its mining beam to transport dilithium from asteroids to its cargo bays, then unloads the unprocessed ore at a nearby Dilithium Freighter. The Klingon collector is armed with only a mining beam, and has no offensive capability. As captaining a Klingon collector would be considered a great dishonour, these ships have been fully automated.

ships.name: Mining Freighter
ships.subtitle: Decommissioned Warship Refit for Battlefield Mining Ops

description.summary: A decommissioned warship stripped of its guns and refitted to process dilithium at the front, with its own flight of mining bees.
Constructs most Klingon warships, can also dock one vessel for repairs at a time
Constructs the Jach'Eng class superweapon, can also dock one Jach'Eng vessel for repairs at a time
A Defence Force shipyard that builds birds-of-prey and lighter cruisers and repairs one ship at a time.
A great Imperial starbase: shipyard, resource depot and fortress in one, with a warp inhibitor to protect the space around it.

The SuQ'jagh assault vessel, created during the last Klingon expansion campaign, was originally designed for planetary assaults. Its role has since been modified to accommodate ship-to-ship combat, focusing on boarding and taking over enemy vessels. The SuQ'jagh is armed with multiple photon torpedo launchers and is crewed with the bravest close quarter warriors in the Empire.

canon.note: A boarding vessel from the Star Trek: Armada games; no wiki page of its own.

description.summary: A fixed Klingon torpedo launcher that hits large ships hard. Best placed in groups.
Replacing the venerable K't'inga in the KDF, the Vor'cha is a large, but nimble, attack cruiser, armed with some of the finest weapons available to the Klingon Defence Forces.

canon.note: Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 20.

description.summary: A subtype of the Stalker, armed with plasma torpedoes. Ill-suited to face smaller capital ships and fighters, it must be escorted to the target.

canon.note: A kitbash of the Starfleet Command II Romulan fighter (the Scythe); also flown in Star Trek: Invasion.

description.summary: The orbital offices of a Romulan colonial administration. A civilian station that takes no part in the fighting.
A Romulan civilian research station. It takes no part in the fighting, though the Tal Shiar takes a close interest in its work.
A civilian trading dock where cargo comes and goes. It takes no part in the fighting.
Freighter outfitted with construction equipment, carries and maintains a flight of construction bees

description.summary: A Romulan work craft that mines, salvages wrecks and repairs damaged ships for the Star Navy.

credits.note: No readme with credits for this model in the mod's source files.

description.summary: The D'Deridex-Class warbird is a massive starship and the flagship of the Romulan fleet and a direct successor to the D'Talla-Class. The Warbird is equipped with cloaking device, as well as plasma torpedoes and disruptors. The combination of offensive strength, comparatively high maneuvrability and stealth make the Warbird a deadly predator and an invaluable asset to to the Romulan fleet.

canon.note: Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 5.

description.summary: The most capable and powerful Romulan fighter yet, armed with a heavy disruptor cannon capable of burning through the shields of an enemy ship, but still best suited to destroy enemy bombers.

canon.note: No page on Memory Alpha or Memory Beta, and nothing found on the web; the mod's own as far as the sources show.

abilities.name: Espionage
abilities.detail: Tal Shiar espionage: reveals cloaked ships across the map.

description.summary:
The Valdore, Commander Donatra's warbird and flagship of the Romulan fleet. It can cloak, and it builds and launches new ships from its own bays.
Commander Donatra's warbird, which fought beside the Enterprise against the Scimitar. She leads a Star Empire rebuilding itself after Shinzon, and her commander's word carries the weight of the new government.

canon.note: Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 31.

description.summary: The Griffin was designed to compliment the Romulan fleet by confusing and disabling the enemy's sensors. Its reinforced shielding and ample crew allow it to be a formidable opponent in combat. All Griffins are armed with powerful disruptors as well as cloaking devices.

canon.note: From Star Trek: Armada II.

description.summary: While the D'Deridex is a powerful warbird, the ship's massive bulk means it is ill-suited to fight smaller ships like the Starfleet Defiant-Class or the Jem'hadar attack ship. The Mogai is the answer to this, combining much of the D'deridex's armament and putting it into a leaner, more agile frame.

canon.note: The screen design is the Valdore type; Memory Beta calls it the Mogai class, and the card game the Norexan. Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 31.

description.summary: The an updated refit to the Nova Z1, this heavier starship boasts improved hull strength and weapons coverage to help support the fighter wings it brings into battle as well as continuing to serve as a forward supply and repair station.

canon.note: No page on Memory Alpha or Memory Beta, and nothing found on the web; the mod's own as far as the sources show.

abilities.detail: Tal Shiar espionage: reveals cloaked ships across the map.

description.summary: A Tal'Kratha-class outpost holding a corner of the Star Empire. It builds ships, docks small craft and takes in mined dilithium, and its warp inhibitor keeps intruders from jumping in unannounced.

The Phoenix was originally developed by the Star Empire as a last resort, should the Romulan Empire fall to invaders. Its potential effect is so devastating, it requires a special shipyard for its construction. Because of the intense burden Phoenix-Class captains must bear, the Tal Shiar has been known to use unorthodox 'conditioning' techniques in their training. These techniques ensure the loyalty and commitment of Phoenix captains to the Star Empire.

canon.note: From Star Trek: Armada II.

description.summary: Sensor pallet that can remotely spy on the enemy without risk of exposure
A fixed Romulan disruptor battery that guards a set area against small ships. Best placed in groups.

The Raptor is equipped with the same tricobalt torpedoes as the Federation Steamrunner Cruiser. Starfleet is still unsure how the Romulans were able to duplicate the technology, but it is suspected that Romulan Tal Shiar operatives infiltrated the Starfleet Corps of Engineers and stole the plans for the weapon. The Raptor is also equipped with a cloaking device, allowing it to move unseen through enemy territory before unloading its barrage of torpedoes on an unsuspecting target.
A Romulan support ship that reinforces allied shields with its own power and repairs damage away from the yards.

canon.note: No page on Memory Alpha or Memory Beta, and nothing found on the web; the mod's own as far as the sources show.

description.summary: A Romulan mining bee that gathers dilithium for the Star Navy, working the asteroid fields close to the fleet.

credits.note: No readme with credits for this model in the mod's source files.

description.summary: A Romulan mining freighter that refines dilithium in the field and keeps a flight of mining bees working around it.
Constructs most Romulan vessels, can also dock one vessel for repairs at a time

credits.note: No readme with credits for this model in the mod's source files.

description.summary: Constructs the Romulan Phoenix class superweapon, can also dock one Phoenix vessel for repairs at a time
A Romulan shipyard that builds the Star Navy's lighter warbirds and repairs one ship at a time.

The Shrike-Class is a favourite of the Tal Shiar, the Romulan Intelligence Agency, due to its stealth and speed. It also is outfitted with a cloaking device allowing Tal Shiar operatives to conduct covert operations in unsanctioned areas of space. Shrike-Class vessels are equipped with two forward firing plasma cannons.

canon.note: From Star Trek: Armada II.

description.summary: A great Romulan stardock: shipyard, resource depot and fortress in one, with a warp inhibitor to protect the space around it.

The Talon was designed to be the eyes and ears of the Romulan fleet when it was introduced in 2363. Its superior speed and manoeuvrability allows it to recon an area of space before the fleet moves in. This ship is armed with a single forward firing plasma cannon and is also equipped with a cloaking device, allowing them to move through enemy space undetected.

canon.note: Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 90.

description.summary: A fixed Romulan torpedo launcher for holding off capital ships. Best placed in groups.

A modern recreation of the warbird used by the Tal Shiar back in the 2150s, the T'varo plays the same role in the Romulan fleet as earlier birds-of-prey: a light attack ship that punches above its' weight, especially in numbers.

canon.note: Based on the 22nd-century Bird-of-Prey.

description.summary: A spiritual successor to the Whitewind-Class cruiser, the Veles has been designed for planetary landings. This heavy cargo and armour combination has been used from kickstarting new colonies to bringing heavy ground weapons platforms straight into combat in the Dominion War.

canon.note: From Star Trek: Armada II.

description.summary: A living ship of Species 8472, grown rather than built. Its organic hull heals itself, and its fluidic weapons can cripple a starship in a few shots.

canon.note: Memory Beta calls this class the Nicor. Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 43.

credits.note: 'Star Trek - Species 8472 Bioship', licensed CC BY 4.0

description.summary: A science vessel wielding the temporal sciences the Voth Doctrine guards so jealously. Lighter in a fight, but its chroniton armament and support systems sharpen an entire Voth battle group.

canon.note: A Star Trek Online temporal science vessel.

description.summary: The mainstay of the Voth battle line. A balanced, resilient cruiser that anchors squadrons of lighter Palisades and holds the centre of any engagement.
A large Voth battleship, heavier and far more powerful than the Bastion cruiser. A standing threat that any enemy fleet must answer.
A Voth city ship, nearly ten kilometres long: a whole society in transwarp-capable space. It builds and repairs the Voth fleet and can swallow smaller vessels whole.

canon.note: The Voth city ship from VOY "Distant Origin"; Citadel is the mod's name. Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 70.

description.summary: Nimble Voth strike craft. A ship-killer best fielded in packs of three to five; tears into corvettes and screens the heavier hulls.

canon.note: No page on Memory Alpha or Memory Beta, and nothing found on the web; the mod's own as far as the sources show.

description.summary: Small, fast and maneuverable, the Palisade is built to fight in squadrons of three or more and to screen heavier Voth hulls such as the Bastion. Deadly to corvettes and strike craft.

canon.note: From VOY "Distant Origin". Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 62.

description.summary: A Voth command carrier that fields and directs wings of strike craft from its flight decks, coordinating the battle from behind its escorts.

canon.note: A Star Trek Online carrier, grown from the Bastion class.

description.summary: The apex of Voth military power. A mobile fortress that anchors a Voth battle line.

canon.note: A Star Trek Online dreadnought; no wiki page of its own.

description.summary: An unarmed Voth tender that repairs damaged hulls in the field, keeping a Voth battle line fighting long after it should have broken.
A vast spaceborne lifeform shaped like a snowflake of crystal. It strips worlds of life and can turn its energy on any ship that comes too close.

canon.note: A spaceborne lifeform, not a ship.

credits.note: No readme with credits for this model in the mod's source files.
